behavior.arguments: rdi is the only pointer argument read (two movzbl loads from rdi+0x160 and rdi+0x189); no other argument is read
behavior.branch_order: je at body offset 13 skips the second load and the xor when the gate byte is zero, landing on the ret; otherwise the second byte is loaded and xor'd with 1; no calls inside the window
behavior.output_shape: rax is fully determined (movzbl zero-extends both bytes; xor $0x1 in eax): 0..255, then ret

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, no runtime rebase

naming_relocation.note: data-pointer reference only, applied at load time; not a direct call
